h100-h200-2gpu-tp-resident-eager.description: Hopper 2-GPU TP, resident components, eager DiT — measured fastest.
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-resident-eager.policy_exception: Measured H100 A/B 2026-07-03 (steady-state single_e2e): speed+compile 0.987/0.997s vs speed-eager 0.701/0.699s vs auto-offload default 0.793/0.799s — compile loses on this 9-step turbo model. Explicit --enable-torch-compile false also future-proofs against speed-mode auto-compile (sglang PR #30016).
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-resident-eager.notes: Validated on H100; hardware list includes h200 for selection parity — re-validate there before publishing h200 numbers.

default.description: Best known vLLM-Omni command for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.

blackwell-flashinfer.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile using FlashInfer attention (validated on B200; the FLASH_ATTN backend hits Hopper-only precompiled kernels and fails with 'no kernel image' on sm_100).
blackwell-flashinfer.notes: Same case/model/steps as default; only the attention backend changes for Blackwell compatibility.

default.description: Best known LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
default.notes: Uses explicit fast attention/offload settings; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.

blackwell-fa2.description: Blackwell LightX2V profile using FlashAttention 2 (validated on B200 via the flux2 blackwell-fa2-flashinfer profile). Same precision class (full-precision, exact attention) as SGLang's FA4 and vLLM-Omni's FlashInfer backend on Blackwell -- flash_attn3/flash_attn4 hit Hopper-only precompiled kernels or a CUDA-toolkit>=13.1 CuTe-DSL requirement not met by this build, so FA2 is the fastest same-class (full-precision) option available here.
blackwell-fa2.notes: Uses the source-built FlashAttention 2 wheel (TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0) already installed for Blackwell; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path. Deliberately NOT using SageAttention here -- it is int8 QK-quantized, a different numeric class from the full-precision attention used elsewhere in this comparison.

h200-fa3-flashinfer.description: H200 fastest available LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
h200-fa3-flashinfer.notes: Uses FlashAttention 3 with FlashInfer RoPE in the isolated H200 LightX2V venv; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official 'Text to Image (Z-Image-Turbo)' blueprint at the case's 9 steps (sglang's progress bar reads 9/9 per request). euler instead of the blueprint's res_multistep: the same one forward per step, and closer to the flow-matching Euler (shift 3) the other rows run. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case.
